messages:
maria: quick Q — I'm tuning alerts for `eu-dedicated-pool`. Can't find a reliable per-pool KV cache hit-rate panel or the autoscaler target timeline in the dashboard. Anyone have links? Also the current pool_saturated alert is quite chatty on short spikes — thinking about increasing window to 5m. cc @alex

alex: sure — there are two dashboards. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/pool-observability/eu-dedicated-pool and the autoscale timeline is on the autoscaler dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/autoscaler/pool-autoscale

joni: metric names to look for: `kvcache_hit_ratio{pool="eu-dedicated"}`, `per_pool_capacity_utilization`, and `autoscaler_target_replicas{pool="eu-dedicated"}`. The per-pool panel is under "Pool Metrics > Per-Pool KV"

sam: fwiw — the alert noise is because `pool_saturated` currently uses `for: 1m`. bumping to `for: 5m` helped us for asia pools last month. also consider switching the expr to `avg_over_time(per_pool_capacity_utilization[2m]) > 0.9` instead of an instant value

lee: +1 to avg_over_time. we should also add a secondary condition to ignore bursts from small-burst pipelines: `and increase(sum(rate(requests_total[1m])) by (pool) < 10)` (so it doesn't fire for tiny traffic blips)

ops-bot: alert update PR #412 opened by @sam -> https://git.internal/redwood/ops-alerts/pull/412 (changes: pool_saturated `for` 5m, use `avg_over_time` 2m, add small-traffic suppression) :shipit:

autoscale-bot: autoscale snapshot for eu-dedicated-pool at 2025-11-02T14:03:21Z -> scaled 8 -> 12 replicas, reason: sustained queue latency > 1200ms; trace: https://traces.redwood.internal/trace/abc123

maria: thanks everyone. Joni — can you paste the exact panel id I should add to the runbook? want to link directly to KV panel and the autoscaler timeline

joni: panel ids: KV panel = 42, autoscale timeline panel = 87. deep link templates: `https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/pool-observability/eu-dedicated-pool?viewPanel=42` and `.../d/autoscaler/pool-autoscale?viewPanel=87`

alex: opened a tiny follow-up on the PR to use `max()` instead of `sum()` in that suppression clause — avoids double-counting across replica-shards: https://git.internal/redwood/ops-alerts/pull/412#discussion_r99

sam: noted, I left a reply. also added a tests job that replays historical burst traces against the rule to check false-positive rate, runs in CI -> `make alert-regression-test`

lee: can someone with runbook perms add the panel links and the autoscale trace link into the eu-dedicated runbook? I can do it if no one is blocked

maria: I can do it now. leaving a note to include the suggested `for: 5m`, the avg_over_time expr, and the small-traffic suppression. will ping once merged

alex: quick sanity: if you want to see raw traces for recent scale events use Jaeger UI: https://jaeger.redwood.internal/search?service=autoscaler&tags.pool=eu-dedicated

maria: perfect. tagging this thread — will follow up after PR merges and runbook update. thanks! :thumbsup:

ops-bot: PR #412 merged by @alex at 2025-11-02T15:10:02Z

maria: mw — merged + runbook updated. will monitor for 48h and report back if noise persists

autoscale-bot: monitor note: observed 3 autoscale events in last 3h (8->12->9->11). linking traces in runbook for review

sam: thanks — if noise continues we can consider changing the severity to warning for a short window and add a paged escalation only if sustained for 30m

lee: cool. if anyone sees repeats after 48h ping #oncall so we can decide on escalation

maria: will do. end."
